comparison.objective: Trace hidden crossed cables and place the two correct plugs in matching holders; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Use interactive tugging to identify cable endpoints, manage deformable cables, and place selected plugs without moving distractors, versus fine rigid-tool adjustment and test cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Both correct plugs must be released in their holders while three distractor plugs remain within 5 cm and no cable pulls out; candidate requires two safe repeatable stops and retained setting.
comparison.reason: Hidden-endpoint identification and deformable manipulation are different from mechanical commissioning.
